# AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/generators/gen_tax_code.py — do not edit manually
# The legislated tax code's per-instrument and per-good effects. Schema and rules:
# docs/systems/tax_code_schema.md. All country scope.
#
# te_tax_gen_init_*: called by te_tax_init_country (te_tax_state_effects.txt). Each write
# happens only if the variable is absent, so an existing value is never overwritten.
# te_tax_gen_sync_*: called by te_tax_sync_collection (te_tax_collection_effects.txt),
# the only writer of a rule-on country's native tax state, which saves
# scope:te_tax_country and scope:te_tax_sponsor first. Each sync removes what the
# enacted code does not hold and adds what it holds and is missing. Amendment and
# goods changes are not visible later in the same effect, so run each at most once
# per effect execution; a call in a later execution then changes nothing. The
# removal loop never touches the enacted amendment, and the add checks only that one.
# te_tax_gen_count_goods_drift: the writer's drift count of goods (te_tax_detect_drift).
# The scheduler's parts follow the syncs: te_tax_gen_sunset_<key>,
# te_tax_gen_commence_<slot>, te_tax_gen_hold_missed_<slot>, te_tax_gen_apply_<slot>,
# te_tax_gen_store_<slot>, te_tax_gen_next_month and te_tax_gen_history_write, called
# by te_tax_schedule_effects.txt. The migration's parts follow:
# te_tax_gen_migrate_rates, te_tax_gen_migrate_goods and te_tax_gen_migrate_provisions,
# called by te_tax_migrate_country (te_tax_migration_effects.txt). The copies for new
# countries close the file: te_tax_gen_copy_code, te_tax_gen_copy_slot_<slot> and
# te_tax_gen_copy_enacted, called by te_tax_civil_war_effects.txt, with the policy
# obligations' te_tax_gen_copy_obligations and te_tax_gen_clear_obligations (plan Task 12).
# The promise lines and the AI's enactment end it (plan 2026-10-03 Task 19):
# te_tax_gen_obl_log_met_<n> and _unmet_<n>, called by te_tax_obl_check_one
# (te_tax_obligation_effects.txt); te_tax_gen_ai_enact_<n>, te_tax_gen_ai_log_enacted_<n> and
# te_tax_gen_ai_log_renegotiated_<n>, called by te_tax_ai_manage_promises (te_tax_ai_effects.txt).

	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_tax_trust_landowners_month } } set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_landowners_month value = -1 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_tax_trust_petty_bourgeoisie_month } } set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_petty_bourgeoisie_month value = -1 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_tax_trust_rural_folk_month } } set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_rural_folk_month value = -1 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_tax_trust_trade_unions_month } } set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_trade_unions_month value = -1 } }
}

# Wage tax: leaves exactly amendment_te_tax_wage_<te_tax_en_wage> on the
# carrier, and none at index 0.
te_tax_gen_sync_wage = {
	active_law:lawgroup_taxation = {
		every_scope_amendment = {
			limit = {
				te_tax_amendment_is_wage = yes
				NOT = { te_tax_amendment_matches_wage = yes }
			}
			remove_amendment = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_en_wage = 1 }
		active_law:lawgroup_taxation = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_te_tax_wage_1 } }
				add_amendment = { type = amendment_te_tax_wage_1 sponsor = scope:te_tax_sponsor cooldown = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_en_wage = 2 }
		active_law:lawgroup_taxation = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_te_tax_wage_2 } }
				add_amendment = { type = amendment_te_tax_wage_2 sponsor = scope:te_tax_sponsor cooldown = 0 }

		}

# carrier, and none at index 0.

		every_scope_amendment = {
			limit = {
				te_tax_amendment_is_head = yes
				NOT = { te_tax_amendment_matches_head = yes }
			}
			remove_amendment = yes
		}
	}

		limit = { var:te_tax_en_head = 1 }

				limit = { NOT = { has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_te_tax_head_30 } }
				add_amendment = { type = amendment_te_tax_head_30 sponsor = scope:te_tax_sponsor cooldown = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Consumption tax rate: leaves exactly amendment_te_tax_cons_<te_tax_en_cons> on the
# carrier, and none at index 0.
te_tax_gen_sync_cons = {
	active_law:lawgroup_taxation = {
		every_scope_amendment = {
			limit = {
				te_tax_amendment_is_cons = yes
				NOT = { te_tax_amendment_matches_cons = yes }
			}
			remove_amendment = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_en_cons = 1 }
		active_law:lawgroup_taxation = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_te_tax_cons_1 } }
				add_amendment = { type = amendment_te_tax_cons_1 sponsor = scope:te_tax_sponsor cooldown = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_en_cons = 2 }
		active_law:lawgroup_taxation = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_te_tax_cons_2 } }
				add_amendment = { type = amendment_te_tax_cons_2 sponsor = scope:te_tax_sponsor cooldown = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_en_cons = 3 }
		active_law:lawgroup_taxation = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_te_tax_cons_3 } }
				add_amendment = { type = amendment_te_tax_cons_3 sponsor = scope:te_tax_sponsor cooldown = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_en_cons = 4 }
		active_law:lawgroup_taxation = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_te_tax_cons_4 } }
				add_amendment = { type = amendment_te_tax_cons_4 sponsor = scope:te_tax_sponsor cooldown = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_en_cons = 5 }
		active_law:lawgroup_taxation = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_te_tax_cons_5 } }
				add_amendment = { type = amendment_te_tax_cons_5 sponsor = scope:te_tax_sponsor cooldown = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_en_cons = 6 }
		active_law:lawgroup_taxation = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_te_tax_cons_6 } }
				add_amendment = { type = amendment_te_tax_cons_6 sponsor = scope:te_tax_sponsor cooldown = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_en_cons = 7 }
		active_law:lawgroup_taxation = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_te_tax_cons_7 } }
				add_amendment = { type = amendment_te_tax_cons_7 sponsor = scope:te_tax_sponsor cooldown = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_en_cons = 8 }
		active_law:lawgroup_taxation = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_te_tax_cons_8 } }
				add_amendment = { type = amendment_te_tax_cons_8 sponsor = scope:te_tax_sponsor cooldown = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_en_cons = 9 }
		active_law:lawgroup_taxation = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_te_tax_cons_9 } }
				add_amendment = { type = amendment_te_tax_cons_9 sponsor = scope:te_tax_sponsor cooldown = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_en_cons = 10 }
		active_law:lawgroup_taxation = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_te_tax_cons_10 } }
				add_amendment = { type = amendment_te_tax_cons_10 sponsor = scope:te_tax_sponsor cooldown = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_en_cons = 11 }
		active_law:lawgroup_taxation = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_te_tax_cons_11 } }
				add_amendment = { type = amendment_te_tax_cons_11 sponsor = scope:te_tax_sponsor cooldown = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_en_cons = 12 }
		active_law:lawgroup_taxation = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_te_tax_cons_12 } }
				add_amendment = { type = amendment_te_tax_cons_12 sponsor = scope:te_tax_sponsor cooldown = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Taxed goods: the native consumption-tax list holds a catalog good exactly when
# te_tax_en_g_<good> = 1, and never holds a good outside the catalog, so the native
# taxed set always equals the enacted one.
te_tax_gen_sync_goods = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_en_g_aeroplanes = 1 NOT = { has_consumption_tax = g:aeroplanes } }
		add_taxed_goods = g:aeroplanes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { var:te_tax_en_g_aeroplanes = 1 } has_consumption_tax = g:aeroplanes }
		remove_taxed_goods = g:aeroplanes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_en_g_automobiles = 1 NOT = { has_consumption_tax = g:automobiles } }
		add_taxed_goods = g:automobiles
	}
	else_if = {

		remove_taxed_goods = g:automobiles
	}
	if = {

		add_taxed_goods = g:clippers
	}

		remove_taxed_goods = g:clippers

	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:sulfur } remove_taxed_goods = g:sulfur }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:tanks } remove_taxed_goods = g:tanks }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:tech_metals } remove_taxed_goods = g:tech_metals }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:tools } remove_taxed_goods = g:tools }
}

# Drift (te_tax_detect_drift, te_tax_collection_effects.txt): +1 to te_tax_drift_goods for
# each good whose native consumption tax differs from the enacted list, counted before
# the sync puts it back. Reads native state; writes only the counter.
te_tax_gen_count_goods_drift = {
	if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { var:te_tax_en_g_aeroplanes = 1 NOT = { has_consumption_tax = g:aeroplanes } } AND = { NOT = { var:te_tax_en_g_aeroplanes = 1 } has_consumption_tax = g:aeroplanes } } } change_variable = { name = te_tax_drift_goods add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { var:te_tax_en_g_automobiles = 1 NOT = { has_consumption_tax = g:automobiles } } AND = { NOT = { var:te_tax_en_g_automobiles = 1 } has_consumption_tax = g:automobiles } } } change_variable = { name = te_tax_drift_goods add = 1 } }

# Customs (plan Task 15; docs/systems/tax_code_schema.md, "Customs schedule"). The native
# level of a good is stored on its market's owner and set with set_<direction>_tariff_level;
# script reads it only through a state's goods (capital ?= { sg:<good> ?= { <direction>_tariff_level
# = <key> } }, vanilla's je_set_up_grain_import form, null-safe: the capital may have no state
# goods for a good; final review A-I3), one branch per level. GOOD is a tradeable good.
# te_tax_gen_customs_set_native_<d>: the market's level becomes the enacted record's.

te_tax_gen_customs_set_native_imp = {
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_en_imp_$GOOD$ = -3 } set_import_tariff_level = { goods = g:$GOOD$ level = max_subventions } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_en_imp_$GOOD$ = -2 } set_import_tariff_level = { goods = g:$GOOD$ level = high_subventions } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_en_imp_$GOOD$ = -1 } set_import_tariff_level = { goods = g:$GOOD$ level = low_subventions } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_en_imp_$GOOD$ = 0 } set_import_tariff_level = { goods = g:$GOOD$ level = no_tariffs_or_subventions } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_en_imp_$GOOD$ = 1 } set_import_tariff_level = { goods = g:$GOOD$ level = low_tariffs } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_en_imp_$GOOD$ = 2 } set_import_tariff_level = { goods = g:$GOOD$ level = high_tariffs } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_en_imp_$GOOD$ = 3 } set_import_tariff_level = { goods = g:$GOOD$ level = max_tariffs } }
}

te_tax_gen_customs_set_native_exp = {
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_en_exp_$GOOD$ = -3 } set_export_tariff_level = { goods = g:$GOOD$ level = max_subventions } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_en_exp_$GOOD$ = -2 } set_export_tariff_level = { goods = g:$GOOD$ level = high_subventions } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_en_exp_$GOOD$ = -1 } set_export_tariff_level = { goods = g:$GOOD$ level = low_subventions } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_en_exp_$GOOD$ = 0 } set_export_tariff_level = { goods = g:$GOOD$ level = no_tariffs_or_subventions } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_en_exp_$GOOD$ = 1 } set_export_tariff_level = { goods = g:$GOOD$ level = low_tariffs } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_en_exp_$GOOD$ = 2 } set_export_tariff_level = { goods = g:$GOOD$ level = high_tariffs } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_en_exp_$GOOD$ = 3 } set_export_tariff_level = { goods = g:$GOOD$ level = max_tariffs } }
}

# te_tax_gen_customs_read_native_<d>: the enacted record becomes the market's level; vanilla's
# default (1, low tariffs) when no level can be read (no capital, or no state
# goods for the good there).

te_tax_gen_customs_read_native_imp = {
	if = { limit = { capital ?= { sg:$GOOD$ ?= { import_tariff_level = max_subventions } } } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_$GOOD$ value = -3 } }
	else_if = { limit = { capital ?= { sg:$GOOD$ ?= { import_tariff_level = high_subventions } } } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_$GOOD$ value = -2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { capital ?= { sg:$GOOD$ ?= { import_tariff_level = low_subventions } } } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_$GOOD$ value = -1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { capital ?= { sg:$GOOD$ ?= { import_tariff_level = no_tariffs_or_subventions } } } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_$GOOD$ value = 0 } }
	else_if = { limit = { capital ?= { sg:$GOOD$ ?= { import_tariff_level = low_tariffs } } } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_$GOOD$ value = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { capital ?= { sg:$GOOD$ ?= { import_tariff_level = high_tariffs } } } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_$GOOD$ value = 2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { capital ?= { sg:$GOOD$ ?= { import_tariff_level = max_tariffs } } } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_$GOOD$ value = 3 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_$GOOD$ value = 1 } }
}

te_tax_gen_customs_read_native_exp = {
	if = { limit = { capital ?= { sg:$GOOD$ ?= { export_tariff_level = max_subventions } } } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_$GOOD$ value = -3 } }
	else_if = { limit = { capital ?= { sg:$GOOD$ ?= { export_tariff_level = high_subventions } } } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_$GOOD$ value = -2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { capital ?= { sg:$GOOD$ ?= { export_tariff_level = low_subventions } } } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_$GOOD$ value = -1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { capital ?= { sg:$GOOD$ ?= { export_tariff_level = no_tariffs_or_subventions } } } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_$GOOD$ value = 0 } }
	else_if = { limit = { capital ?= { sg:$GOOD$ ?= { export_tariff_level = low_tariffs } } } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_$GOOD$ value = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { capital ?= { sg:$GOOD$ ?= { export_tariff_level = high_tariffs } } } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_$GOOD$ value = 2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { capital ?= { sg:$GOOD$ ?= { export_tariff_level = max_tariffs } } } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_$GOOD$ value = 3 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_$GOOD$ value = 1 } }
}

# Customs migration (te_tax_migrate_customs, te_tax_migration_effects.txt): every tradeable good's
# native import and export level becomes the code's, and no re-assert is pending and no good
# blocked. Only for a country eligible to hold its customs (te_tax_customs_eligible).
te_tax_gen_migrate_customs = {
	te_tax_gen_customs_read_native_imp = { GOOD = advanced_materials }
	te_tax_gen_customs_read_native_exp = { GOOD = advanced_materials }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_advanced_materials } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_advanced_materials }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_advanced_materials } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_advanced_materials }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_advanced_materials } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_advanced_materials }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_advanced_materials } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_advanced_materials }
	te_tax_gen_customs_read_native_imp = { GOOD = aeroplanes }
	te_tax_gen_customs_read_native_exp = { GOOD = aeroplanes }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_aeroplanes } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_aeroplanes }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_aeroplanes } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_aeroplanes }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_aeroplanes } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_aeroplanes }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_aeroplanes } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_aeroplanes }
	te_tax_gen_customs_read_native_imp = { GOOD = ammunition }
	te_tax_gen_customs_read_native_exp = { GOOD = ammunition }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_ammunition } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_ammunition }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_ammunition } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_ammunition }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_ammunition } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_ammunition }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_ammunition } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_ammunition }
	te_tax_gen_customs_read_native_imp = { GOOD = artillery }
	te_tax_gen_customs_read_native_exp = { GOOD = artillery }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_artillery } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_artillery }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_artillery } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_artillery }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_artillery } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_artillery }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_artillery } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_artillery }
	te_tax_gen_customs_read_native_imp = { GOOD = automobiles }
	te_tax_gen_customs_read_native_exp = { GOOD = automobiles }

# Customs sync (te_tax_sync_customs, te_tax_collection_effects.txt, only while the code holds the
# country's customs). Per tradeable good and direction, when the market's level differs from the
# code's, the code's level is set again and, on the month's first customs sync (local
# te_tax_cu_counts = 1), the failed re-asserts are counted (te_tax_cretry_<d>_<good>). Once
# te_tax_customs_adopt_after monthly re-asserts in a row have not taken (a treaty forbids the
# level, or the 3-month tariff cooldown kept refusing it), the market's level is adopted into the
# code instead, the direction is marked blocked (te_tax_cblock_<d>_<good>, for the review) and
# counted (local te_tax_cu_adopted), so the caller moves the customs external version once and
# writes one history entry with the count. A re-assert that took (the level matches again while a
# count stands) clears the count and the direction's blocked mark. The counter and the blocked
# mark are transient flags, not schema tokens: written when set, removed when cleared.
te_tax_gen_sync_customs = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_en_imp_advanced_materials NOT = { te_tax_gen_customs_matches_imp = { GOOD = advanced_materials } } }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_tax_cu_counts = 1 has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_advanced_materials var:te_tax_cretry_imp_advanced_materials >= te_tax_customs_adopt_after }
			te_tax_gen_customs_read_native_imp = { GOOD = advanced_materials }
			remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_advanced_materials
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_cblock_imp_advanced_materials value = 1 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_tax_cu_adopted add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			te_tax_gen_customs_set_native_imp = { GOOD = advanced_materials }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_tax_cu_counts = 1 }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_advanced_materials } change_variable = { name = te_tax_cretry_imp_advanced_materials add = 1 } }
				else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_cretry_imp_advanced_materials value = 1 } }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_advanced_materials } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_advanced_materials if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_advanced_materials } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_advanced_materials } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_en_exp_advanced_materials NOT = { te_tax_gen_customs_matches_exp = { GOOD = advanced_materials } } }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_tax_cu_counts = 1 has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_advanced_materials var:te_tax_cretry_exp_advanced_materials >= te_tax_customs_adopt_after }
			te_tax_gen_customs_read_native_exp = { GOOD = advanced_materials }
			remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_advanced_materials
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_cblock_exp_advanced_materials value = 1 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_tax_cu_adopted add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			te_tax_gen_customs_set_native_exp = { GOOD = advanced_materials }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_tax_cu_counts = 1 }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_advanced_materials } change_variable = { name = te_tax_cretry_exp_advanced_materials add = 1 } }
				else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_cretry_exp_advanced_materials value = 1 } }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_advanced_materials } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_advanced_materials if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_advanced_materials } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_advanced_materials } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_en_imp_aeroplanes NOT = { te_tax_gen_customs_matches_imp = { GOOD = aeroplanes } } }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_tax_cu_counts = 1 has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_aeroplanes var:te_tax_cretry_imp_aeroplanes >= te_tax_customs_adopt_after }
			te_tax_gen_customs_read_native_imp = { GOOD = aeroplanes }
			remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_aeroplanes
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_cblock_imp_aeroplanes value = 1 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_tax_cu_adopted add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			te_tax_gen_customs_set_native_imp = { GOOD = aeroplanes }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_tax_cu_counts = 1 }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_aeroplanes } change_variable = { name = te_tax_cretry_imp_aeroplanes add = 1 } }
				else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_cretry_imp_aeroplanes value = 1 } }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_aeroplanes } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_aeroplanes if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_aeroplanes } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_aeroplanes } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_en_exp_aeroplanes NOT = { te_tax_gen_customs_matches_exp = { GOOD = aeroplanes } } }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_tax_cu_counts = 1 has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_aeroplanes var:te_tax_cretry_exp_aeroplanes >= te_tax_customs_adopt_after }
			te_tax_gen_customs_read_native_exp = { GOOD = aeroplanes }
			remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_aeroplanes
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_cblock_exp_aeroplanes value = 1 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_tax_cu_adopted add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			te_tax_gen_customs_set_native_exp = { GOOD = aeroplanes }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_tax_cu_counts = 1 }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_aeroplanes } change_variable = { name = te_tax_cretry_exp_aeroplanes add = 1 } }
				else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_cretry_exp_aeroplanes value = 1 } }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_aeroplanes } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_aeroplanes if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_aeroplanes } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_aeroplanes } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_en_imp_ammunition NOT = { te_tax_gen_customs_matches_imp = { GOOD = ammunition } } }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_tax_cu_counts = 1 has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_ammunition var:te_tax_cretry_imp_ammunition >= te_tax_customs_adopt_after }
			te_tax_gen_customs_read_native_imp = { GOOD = ammunition }
			remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_ammunition
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_cblock_imp_ammunition value = 1 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_tax_cu_adopted add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			te_tax_gen_customs_set_native_imp = { GOOD = ammunition }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_tax_cu_counts = 1 }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_ammunition } change_variable = { name = te_tax_cretry_imp_ammunition add = 1 } }
				else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_cretry_imp_ammunition value = 1 } }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_ammunition } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_ammunition if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_ammunition } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_ammunition } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_en_exp_ammunition NOT = { te_tax_gen_customs_matches_exp = { GOOD = ammunition } } }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_tax_cu_counts = 1 has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_ammunition var:te_tax_cretry_exp_ammunition >= te_tax_customs_adopt_after }
			te_tax_gen_customs_read_native_exp = { GOOD = ammunition }
			remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_ammunition
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_cblock_exp_ammunition value = 1 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_tax_cu_adopted add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			te_tax_gen_customs_set_native_exp = { GOOD = ammunition }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_tax_cu_counts = 1 }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_ammunition } change_variable = { name = te_tax_cretry_exp_ammunition add = 1 } }
				else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_cretry_exp_ammunition value = 1 } }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_ammunition } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_ammunition if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_ammunition } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_ammunition } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_en_imp_artillery NOT = { te_tax_gen_customs_matches_imp = { GOOD = artillery } } }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_tax_cu_counts = 1 has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_artillery var:te_tax_cretry_imp_artillery >= te_tax_customs_adopt_after }
			te_tax_gen_customs_read_native_imp = { GOOD = artillery }
			remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_artillery
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_cblock_imp_artillery value = 1 }

		else = {
			te_tax_gen_customs_set_native_imp = { GOOD = artillery }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_tax_cu_counts = 1 }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_artillery } change_variable = { name = te_tax_cretry_imp_artillery add = 1 } }
				else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_cretry_imp_artillery value = 1 } }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_artillery } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_artillery if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_artillery } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_artillery } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_en_exp_artillery NOT = { te_tax_gen_customs_matches_exp = { GOOD = artillery } } }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_tax_cu_counts = 1 has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_artillery var:te_tax_cretry_exp_artillery >= te_tax_customs_adopt_after }
			te_tax_gen_customs_read_native_exp = { GOOD = artillery }
			remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_artillery
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_cblock_exp_artillery value = 1 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_tax_cu_adopted add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			te_tax_gen_customs_set_native_exp = { GOOD = artillery }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_tax_cu_counts = 1 }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_artillery } change_variable = { name = te_tax_cretry_exp_artillery add = 1 } }
				else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_cretry_exp_artillery value = 1 } }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_artillery } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_artillery if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_artillery } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_artillery } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_en_imp_automobiles NOT = { te_tax_gen_customs_matches_imp = { GOOD = automobiles } } }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_tax_cu_counts = 1 has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_automobiles var:te_tax_cretry_imp_automobiles >= te_tax_customs_adopt_after }
			te_tax_gen_customs_read_native_imp = { GOOD = automobiles }
			remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_automobiles
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_cblock_imp_automobiles value = 1 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_tax_cu_adopted add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			te_tax_gen_customs_set_native_imp = { GOOD = automobiles }

		}
		else = {
			te_tax_gen_customs_set_native_imp = { GOOD = tourism }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_tax_cu_counts = 1 }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_tourism } change_variable = { name = te_tax_cretry_imp_tourism add = 1 } }
				else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_cretry_imp_tourism value = 1 } }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_tourism } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_tourism if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_tourism } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_tourism } }

			te_tax_gen_customs_read_native_exp = { GOOD = tourism }
			remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_tourism
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_cblock_exp_tourism value = 1 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_tax_cu_adopted add = 1 }
		}
		else = {

# Drops every failed re-assert count and blocked mark (customs authority lost, a release, a
# civil war's reunification; final review A-Minor 7): the next sync that holds the customs
# re-asserts afresh, counting from 0, and the review shows no block the winner never met.

# Wage tax: executes the enacted value's sunset once its month has come
# (rule 2). It runs only when the value has been operative since an earlier month,
# so a package's own sunset can never share its commencement call; otherwise it
# waits for next month. A late sunset catches up. One without a successor is
# dropped, not deferred, so it cannot hold te_tax_next_month in the past.
te_tax_gen_sunset_wage = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_en_wage_exp >= 0
			var:te_tax_en_wage_exp <= var:te_tax_now
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_tax_en_wage_succ < 0 }
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage_exp value = -1 }
			debug_log = "TE_TAX sunset_dropped wage: no successor recorded; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:te_tax_en_wage_since < var:te_tax_now }
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = var:te_tax_en_wage_succ }
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage_since value = var:te_tax_now }
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage_exp value = -1 }
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage_succ value = -1 }
			change_variable = { name = te_tax_code_version add = 1 }
			te_tax_gen_history_write = { KIND = 2 SLOT = none INST = 1 }
			debug_log = "TE_TAX sunset wage; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
		}
		else = {
			debug_log = "TE_TAX sunset_deferred wage: operative only since this month; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
		}
	}
}

# Slot a: commences in its due month and in no other (rule 3). The processor runs
# on the 1st, so the package takes effect from the 1st. If a provision it touches was
# changed outside legislation since approval (te_tax_xver_*), the whole package holds
# and collections stay as they are. A due month already past holds it as missed. The
# obligations bound to it start with it (te_tax_obl_start), and wait while it is held.
te_tax_gen_commence_a = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_pa_on = 1
			var:te_tax_pa_state = 1
			var:te_tax_pa_due = var:te_tax_now
		}
		if = {
			limit = { te_tax_gen_package_current_a = yes }
			te_tax_gen_apply_a = yes
			change_variable = { name = te_tax_code_version add = 1 }
			# The obligations bound to this package start their clocks this month (plan Task 12).
			te_tax_obl_start = { SLOT = a }
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_on value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_state value = 0 }
			te_tax_gen_history_write = { KIND = 1 SLOT = a INST = 0 }
			debug_log = "TE_TAX commenced slot=a; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_state value = 2 }
			te_tax_gen_history_write = { KIND = 3 SLOT = a INST = 0 }
			debug_log = "TE_TAX held_conflict slot=a: a touched provision changed outside legislation; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
		}
	}
	else = {
		te_tax_gen_hold_missed_a = yes
	}
}

# Slot a: an awaiting package whose due month has passed holds as missed; it never
# commences late (spec: missed dates need explicit rescheduling). The watchdog calls
# this too, because it fires only once the month has passed.
te_tax_gen_hold_missed_a = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_pa_on = 1
			var:te_tax_pa_state = 1
			var:te_tax_pa_due < var:te_tax_now
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_state value = 3 }
		te_tax_gen_history_write = { KIND = 4 SLOT = a INST = 0 }
		debug_log = "TE_TAX held_missed slot=a: due month passed without commencement; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
	}
}

# Slot a: copies every field the package touches into the enacted code. Only
# te_tax_gen_commence_<slot> calls it, inside the processor, which has set te_tax_now,
# run this month's sunsets first and syncs collection once after every slot.
# Supersession of the enacted provision happens here, at commencement, never at
# approval: the package replaces the value and its sunset. With no sunset of its own
# the change is permanent and clears any pending sunset (_exp and _succ = -1). With
# one, the provision reverts to the underlying permanent rate: a sunset still pending
# now (this month's have run, so it is in the future) keeps its successor; otherwise
# the rate in force is the successor. Both are captured before anything is
# overwritten. The stored te_tax_p<slot>_<key>_succ is only the review's preview and
# is never read here.
te_tax_gen_apply_a = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_pa_wage >= 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_tax_pa_wage_exp >= 0 }
			# A pending sunset with a successor keeps it; otherwise the rate in force.
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						var:te_tax_en_wage_exp < 0
						var:te_tax_en_wage_succ < 0
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage_succ value = var:te_tax_en_wage }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage_succ value = -1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = var:te_tax_pa_wage }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage_since value = var:te_tax_now }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage_exp value = var:te_tax_pa_wage_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_pa_div >= 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_tax_pa_div_exp >= 0 }
			# A pending sunset with a successor keeps it; otherwise the rate in force.
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						var:te_tax_en_div_exp < 0
						var:te_tax_en_div_succ < 0
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div_succ value = var:te_tax_en_div }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div_succ value = -1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = var:te_tax_pa_div }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div_since value = var:te_tax_now }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div_exp value = var:te_tax_pa_div_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_pa_land >= 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_tax_pa_land_exp >= 0 }
			# A pending sunset with a successor keeps it; otherwise the rate in force.
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						var:te_tax_en_land_exp < 0
						var:te_tax_en_land_succ < 0
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land_succ value = var:te_tax_en_land }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land_succ value = -1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = var:te_tax_pa_land }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land_since value = var:te_tax_now }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land_exp value = var:te_tax_pa_land_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_pa_head >= 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_tax_pa_head_exp >= 0 }
			# A pending sunset with a successor keeps it; otherwise the rate in force.
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						var:te_tax_en_head_exp < 0
						var:te_tax_en_head_succ < 0
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head_succ value = var:te_tax_en_head }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head_succ value = -1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = var:te_tax_pa_head }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head_since value = var:te_tax_now }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head_exp value = var:te_tax_pa_head_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_pa_cons >= 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_tax_pa_cons_exp >= 0 }
			# A pending sunset with a successor keeps it; otherwise the rate in force.
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						var:te_tax_en_cons_exp < 0
						var:te_tax_en_cons_succ < 0
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons_succ value = var:te_tax_en_cons }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons_succ value = -1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = var:te_tax_pa_cons }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons_since value = var:te_tax_now }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons_exp value = var:te_tax_pa_cons_exp }
	}
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_aeroplanes >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_aeroplanes value = var:te_tax_pa_g_aeroplanes } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_automobiles >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_automobiles value = var:te_tax_pa_g_automobiles } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_clippers >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_clippers value = var:te_tax_pa_g_clippers } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_clothes >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_clothes value = var:te_tax_pa_g_clothes } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_coal >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_coal value = var:te_tax_pa_g_coal } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_coffee >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_coffee value = var:te_tax_pa_g_coffee } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_consumer_appliances >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_consumer_appliances value = var:te_tax_pa_g_consumer_appliances } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_digital_access >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_digital_access value = var:te_tax_pa_g_digital_access } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_digital_assets >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_digital_assets value = var:te_tax_pa_g_digital_assets } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_electricity >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_electricity value = var:te_tax_pa_g_electricity } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_fabric >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_fabric value = var:te_tax_pa_g_fabric } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_fine_art >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_fine_art value = var:te_tax_pa_g_fine_art } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_fish >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_fish value = var:te_tax_pa_g_fish } }

	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_meat >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_meat value = var:te_tax_pa_g_meat } }

	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_opium >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_opium value = var:te_tax_pa_g_opium } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_paper >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_paper value = var:te_tax_pa_g_paper } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_porcelain >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_porcelain value = var:te_tax_pa_g_porcelain } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_radios >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_radios value = var:te_tax_pa_g_radios } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_services >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_services value = var:te_tax_pa_g_services } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_silk >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_silk value = var:te_tax_pa_g_silk } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_small_arms >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_small_arms value = var:te_tax_pa_g_small_arms } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_steamers >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_steamers value = var:te_tax_pa_g_steamers } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_sugar >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_sugar value = var:te_tax_pa_g_sugar } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_tea >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_tea value = var:te_tax_pa_g_tea } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_telephones >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_telephones value = var:te_tax_pa_g_telephones } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_tobacco >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_tobacco value = var:te_tax_pa_g_tobacco } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_tourism >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_tourism value = var:te_tax_pa_g_tourism } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_transportation >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_transportation value = var:te_tax_pa_g_transportation } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_wine >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_wine value = var:te_tax_pa_g_wine } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_wood >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_wood value = var:te_tax_pa_g_wood } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_agrel >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_agrel value = var:te_tax_pa_agrel } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_regrel >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_regrel value = var:te_tax_pa_regrel } }
	# Customs (plan Task 15), only while the code holds the country's customs (a package
	# that touches them is current only if no market change moved te_tax_xver_customs since
	# approval): each level the package sets becomes the enacted one, with the good's failed
	# re-assert count and blocked mark dropped; the sync then sets the market's level.
	if = {
		limit = { te_tax_customs_authority = yes has_variable = te_tax_pa_pver_customs }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_imp_advanced_materials >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_advanced_materials value = var:te_tax_pa_imp_advanced_materials } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_advanced_materials } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_advanced_materials } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_advanced_materials } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_advanced_materials } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_exp_advanced_materials >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_advanced_materials value = var:te_tax_pa_exp_advanced_materials } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_advanced_materials } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_advanced_materials } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_advanced_materials } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_advanced_materials } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_imp_aeroplanes >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_aeroplanes value = var:te_tax_pa_imp_aeroplanes } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_aeroplanes } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_aeroplanes } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_aeroplanes } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_aeroplanes } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_exp_aeroplanes >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_aeroplanes value = var:te_tax_pa_exp_aeroplanes } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_aeroplanes } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_aeroplanes } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_aeroplanes } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_aeroplanes } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_imp_ammunition >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_ammunition value = var:te_tax_pa_imp_ammunition } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_ammunition } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_ammunition } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_ammunition } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_ammunition } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_exp_ammunition >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_ammunition value = var:te_tax_pa_exp_ammunition } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_ammunition } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_ammunition } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_ammunition } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_ammunition } }

		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_imp_automobiles >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_automobiles value = var:te_tax_pa_imp_automobiles } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_automobiles } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_automobiles } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_automobiles } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_automobiles } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_exp_automobiles >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_automobiles value = var:te_tax_pa_exp_automobiles } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_automobiles } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_automobiles } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_automobiles } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_automobiles } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_imp_clippers >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_clippers value = var:te_tax_pa_imp_clippers } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_clippers } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_clippers } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_clippers } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_clippers } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_exp_clippers >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_clippers value = var:te_tax_pa_exp_clippers } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_clippers } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_clippers } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_clippers } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_clippers } }

		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_exp_clothes >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_clothes value = var:te_tax_pa_exp_clothes } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_clothes } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_clothes } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_clothes } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_clothes } }

		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_imp_radios >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_radios value = var:te_tax_pa_imp_radios } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_radios } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_radios } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_radios } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_radios } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_exp_radios >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_radios value = var:te_tax_pa_exp_radios } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_radios } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_radios } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_radios } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_radios } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_imp_robotics >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_robotics value = var:te_tax_pa_imp_robotics } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_robotics } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_robotics } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_robotics } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_robotics } }

		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_imp_rubber >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_rubber value = var:te_tax_pa_imp_rubber } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_rubber } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_rubber } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_rubber } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_rubber } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_exp_rubber >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_rubber value = var:te_tax_pa_exp_rubber } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_rubber } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_rubber } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_rubber } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_rubber } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_imp_silk >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_silk value = var:te_tax_pa_imp_silk } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_silk } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_silk } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_silk } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_silk } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_exp_silk >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_silk value = var:te_tax_pa_exp_silk } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_silk } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_silk } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_silk } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_silk } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_imp_small_arms >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_small_arms value = var:te_tax_pa_imp_small_arms } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_small_arms } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_small_arms } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_small_arms } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_small_arms } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_exp_small_arms >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_small_arms value = var:te_tax_pa_exp_small_arms } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_small_arms } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_small_arms } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_small_arms } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_small_arms } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_imp_steamers >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_steamers value = var:te_tax_pa_imp_steamers } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_steamers } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_steamers } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_steamers } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_steamers } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_exp_steamers >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_steamers value = var:te_tax_pa_exp_steamers } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_steamers } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_steamers } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_steamers } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_steamers } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_imp_steel >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_steel value = var:te_tax_pa_imp_steel } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_steel } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_steel } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_steel } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_steel } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_exp_steel >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_steel value = var:te_tax_pa_exp_steel } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_steel } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_steel } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_steel } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_steel } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_imp_sugar >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_sugar value = var:te_tax_pa_imp_sugar } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_sugar } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_sugar } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_sugar } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_sugar } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_exp_sugar >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_sugar value = var:te_tax_pa_exp_sugar } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_sugar } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_sugar } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_sugar } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_sugar } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_imp_sulfur >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_sulfur value = var:te_tax_pa_imp_sulfur } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_sulfur } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_sulfur } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_sulfur } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_sulfur } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_exp_sulfur >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_sulfur value = var:te_tax_pa_exp_sulfur } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_sulfur } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_sulfur } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_sulfur } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_sulfur } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_imp_tanks >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_tanks value = var:te_tax_pa_imp_tanks } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_tanks } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_tanks } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_tanks } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_tanks } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_exp_tanks >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_tanks value = var:te_tax_pa_exp_tanks } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_tanks } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_tanks } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_tanks } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_tanks } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_imp_tea >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_tea value = var:te_tax_pa_imp_tea } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_tea } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_tea } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_tea } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_tea } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_exp_tea >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_tea value = var:te_tax_pa_exp_tea } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_tea } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_tea } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_tea } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_tea } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_imp_tech_metals >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_tech_metals value = var:te_tax_pa_imp_tech_metals } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_tech_metals } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_tech_metals } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_tech_metals } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_tech_metals } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_exp_tech_metals >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_tech_metals value = var:te_tax_pa_exp_tech_metals } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_tech_metals } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_tech_metals } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_tech_metals } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_tech_metals } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_imp_telephones >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_telephones value = var:te_tax_pa_imp_telephones } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_telephones } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_telephones } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_telephones } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_telephones } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_exp_telephones >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_telephones value = var:te_tax_pa_exp_telephones } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_telephones } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_telephones } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_telephones } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_telephones } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_imp_tobacco >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_tobacco value = var:te_tax_pa_imp_tobacco } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_tobacco } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_tobacco } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_tobacco } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_tobacco } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_exp_tobacco >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_tobacco value = var:te_tax_pa_exp_tobacco } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_tobacco } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_tobacco } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_tobacco } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_tobacco } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_imp_tools >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_tools value = var:te_tax_pa_imp_tools } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_tools } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_tools } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_tools } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_tools } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_exp_tools >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_tools value = var:te_tax_pa_exp_tools } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_tools } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_tools } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_tools } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_tools } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_imp_tourism >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_tourism value = var:te_tax_pa_imp_tourism } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_tourism } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_tourism } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_tourism } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_tourism } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_exp_tourism >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_tourism value = var:te_tax_pa_exp_tourism } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_tourism } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_tourism } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_tourism } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_tourism } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_imp_wine >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_wine value = var:te_tax_pa_imp_wine } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_wine } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_wine } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_wine } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_wine } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_exp_wine >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_wine value = var:te_tax_pa_exp_wine } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_wine } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_wine } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_wine } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_wine } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_imp_wood >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_wood value = var:te_tax_pa_imp_wood } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_wood } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_wood } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_wood } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_wood } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_exp_wood >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_wood value = var:te_tax_pa_exp_wood } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_wood } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_wood } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_wood } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_wood } }
	}
	# A package that restates regional relief names its whole state set, its own list
	# te_tax_pa_relief_states: it replaces the enacted list te_tax_en_relief_states (the canonical set,
	# at most three) with the states in it that this code keeps (te_tax_relief_listed_state_kept:
	# its own, or its civil-war counterpart's while a war lasts). The state marks
	# (te_tax_relief_state) follow from the list in the writer's relief sync
	# (te_tax_rebuild_relief_marks), which the processor runs after this month's
	# commencements. The slot's list is consumed either way.
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_pa_regrel_states_set = 1 }
		save_scope_as = te_tax_country
		if = { limit = { has_variable_list = te_tax_en_relief_states } clear_variable_list = te_tax_en_relief_states }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable_list = te_tax_pa_relief_states }
			every_in_list = {
				variable = te_tax_pa_relief_states
				limit = { te_tax_relief_listed_state_kept = yes }
				scope:te_tax_country = { add_to_variable_list = { name = te_tax_en_relief_states target = PREV } }
			}
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { has_variable_list = te_tax_pa_relief_states } clear_variable_list = te_tax_pa_relief_states }
}

# Slot a: writes an approved package from the bill record (te_tax_bl_*). Called
# only through te_tax_store_package, after te_tax_can_store_package and with
# scope:te_tax_country saved. Every payload field is written, so nothing stale from an
# earlier package survives. A sunset is due + offset, written only for an offset of at
# least one month. _succ is a preview for the review only (commencement decides the
# successor then, by te_tax_gen_apply_<slot>'s rule): the underlying permanent rate,
# from the other slot's awaiting package if it touches the provision earlier, else
# from the enacted provision. seq = one above both slots. The slot is switched on last.
# _due0 keeps the approved month and _pver_<group> the planned versions after this
# approval, for te_tax_cmd_package_reschedule: a missed package may move only a few
# months, and only while no later approval has touched what it changes.
te_tax_gen_store_a = {
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_due value = var:te_tax_bl_due }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_due0 value = var:te_tax_bl_due }
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_pb_seq > var:te_tax_pa_seq }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_seq value = var:te_tax_pb_seq }
	}
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_seq add = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_wage value = var:te_tax_bl_wage }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_xver_wage value = var:te_tax_bl_xver_wage }
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_bl_wage >= 0
			var:te_tax_bl_wage_sun >= 1
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_wage_exp value = var:te_tax_bl_due }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_wage_exp add = var:te_tax_bl_wage_sun }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_wage_succ value = var:te_tax_en_wage }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:te_tax_en_wage_exp >= 0
				var:te_tax_en_wage_succ >= 0
			}
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_wage_succ value = var:te_tax_en_wage_succ }
		}
		# The other slot's payload exists only while it is on, so read it nested.
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:te_tax_pb_on = 1
				var:te_tax_pb_state = 1
				var:te_tax_pb_due < var:te_tax_bl_due
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_tax_pb_wage >= 0 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_wage_succ value = var:te_tax_pb_wage }
				if = {
					limit = {
						var:te_tax_pb_wage_exp >= 0
						var:te_tax_pb_wage_succ >= 0
					}
					set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_wage_succ value = var:te_tax_pb_wage_succ }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_wage_exp value = -1 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_wage_succ value = -1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_div value = var:te_tax_bl_div }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_xver_div value = var:te_tax_bl_xver_div }
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_bl_div >= 0
			var:te_tax_bl_div_sun >= 1
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_div_exp value = var:te_tax_bl_due }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_div_exp add = var:te_tax_bl_div_sun }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_div_succ value = var:te_tax_en_div }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:te_tax_en_div_exp >= 0
				var:te_tax_en_div_succ >= 0
			}
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_div_succ value = var:te_tax_en_div_succ }
		}
		# The other slot's payload exists only while it is on, so read it nested.
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:te_tax_pb_on = 1
				var:te_tax_pb_state = 1
				var:te_tax_pb_due < var:te_tax_bl_due
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_tax_pb_div >= 0 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_div_succ value = var:te_tax_pb_div }
				if = {
					limit = {
						var:te_tax_pb_div_exp >= 0
						var:te_tax_pb_div_succ >= 0
					}
					set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_div_succ value = var:te_tax_pb_div_succ }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_div_exp value = -1 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_div_succ value = -1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_land value = var:te_tax_bl_land }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_xver_land value = var:te_tax_bl_xver_land }
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_bl_land >= 0
			var:te_tax_bl_land_sun >= 1
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_land_exp value = var:te_tax_bl_due }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_land_exp add = var:te_tax_bl_land_sun }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_land_succ value = var:te_tax_en_land }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:te_tax_en_land_exp >= 0
				var:te_tax_en_land_succ >= 0
			}
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_land_succ value = var:te_tax_en_land_succ }
		}
		# The other slot's payload exists only while it is on, so read it nested.
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:te_tax_pb_on = 1
				var:te_tax_pb_state = 1
				var:te_tax_pb_due < var:te_tax_bl_due
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_tax_pb_land >= 0 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_land_succ value = var:te_tax_pb_land }
				if = {
					limit = {
						var:te_tax_pb_land_exp >= 0
						var:te_tax_pb_land_succ >= 0
					}
					set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_land_succ value = var:te_tax_pb_land_succ }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_land_exp value = -1 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_land_succ value = -1 }
	}

	# Regional relief: a bill that touches it (te_tax_bl_regrel >= 0) names its whole
	# state set in te_tax_bl_relief_states, possibly none, copied into the slot's te_tax_pa_relief_states;
	# commencement replaces the enacted list with it.
	if = { limit = { has_variable_list = te_tax_pa_relief_states } clear_variable_list = te_tax_pa_relief_states }
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_bl_regrel >= 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_regrel_states_set value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable_list = te_tax_bl_relief_states }
			every_in_list = {
				variable = te_tax_bl_relief_states
				scope:te_tax_country = { add_to_variable_list = { name = te_tax_pa_relief_states target = PREV } }
			}
		}
	}

		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_regrel_states_set value = 0 }

		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_imp_tourism value = var:te_tax_bl_imp_tourism }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_exp_tourism value = var:te_tax_bl_exp_tourism }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_imp_wine value = var:te_tax_bl_imp_wine }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_exp_wine value = var:te_tax_bl_exp_wine }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_imp_wood value = var:te_tax_bl_imp_wood }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_exp_wood value = var:te_tax_bl_exp_wood }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_xver_customs value = var:te_tax_bl_xver_customs }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_pver_customs value = var:te_tax_pver_customs }
	}
	if = { limit = { is_ai = no } debug_log = "TE_TAX stored slot=a; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]" }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_state value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_on value = 1 }
}

# Slot b: commences in its due month and in no other (rule 3). The processor runs
# on the 1st, so the package takes effect from the 1st. If a provision it touches was
# changed outside legislation since approval (te_tax_xver_*), the whole package holds
# and collections stay as they are. A due month already past holds it as missed. The
# obligations bound to it start with it (te_tax_obl_start), and wait while it is held.
te_tax_gen_commence_b = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_pb_on = 1
			var:te_tax_pb_state = 1
			var:te_tax_pb_due = var:te_tax_now
		}
		if = {
			limit = { te_tax_gen_package_current_b = yes }
			te_tax_gen_apply_b = yes
			change_variable = { name = te_tax_code_version add = 1 }
			# The obligations bound to this package start their clocks this month (plan Task 12).
			te_tax_obl_start = { SLOT = b }
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_on value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_state value = 0 }
			te_tax_gen_history_write = { KIND = 1 SLOT = b INST = 0 }
			debug_log = "TE_TAX commenced slot=b; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_state value = 2 }
			te_tax_gen_history_write = { KIND = 3 SLOT = b INST = 0 }
			debug_log = "TE_TAX held_conflict slot=b: a touched provision changed outside legislation; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
		}
	}
	else = {
		te_tax_gen_hold_missed_b = yes
	}
}

# Slot b: an awaiting package whose due month has passed holds as missed; it never
# commences late (spec: missed dates need explicit rescheduling). The watchdog calls
# this too, because it fires only once the month has passed.
te_tax_gen_hold_missed_b = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_pb_on = 1
			var:te_tax_pb_state = 1
			var:te_tax_pb_due < var:te_tax_now
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_state value = 3 }
		te_tax_gen_history_write = { KIND = 4 SLOT = b INST = 0 }
		debug_log = "TE_TAX held_missed slot=b: due month passed without commencement; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
	}
}

# Slot b: copies every field the package touches into the enacted code. Only
# te_tax_gen_commence_<slot> calls it, inside the processor, which has set te_tax_now,
# run this month's sunsets first and syncs collection once after every slot.
# Supersession of the enacted provision happens here, at commencement, never at
# approval: the package replaces the value and its sunset. With no sunset of its own
# the change is permanent and clears any pending sunset (_exp and _succ = -1). With
# one, the provision reverts to the underlying permanent rate: a sunset still pending
# now (this month's have run, so it is in the future) keeps its successor; otherwise
# the rate in force is the successor. Both are captured before anything is
# overwritten. The stored te_tax_p<slot>_<key>_succ is only the review's preview and
# is never read here.
te_tax_gen_apply_b = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_pb_wage >= 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_tax_pb_wage_exp >= 0 }
			# A pending sunset with a successor keeps it; otherwise the rate in force.
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						var:te_tax_en_wage_exp < 0
						var:te_tax_en_wage_succ < 0
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage_succ value = var:te_tax_en_wage }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage_succ value = -1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = var:te_tax_pb_wage }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage_since value = var:te_tax_now }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage_exp value = var:te_tax_pb_wage_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_pb_div >= 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_tax_pb_div_exp >= 0 }
			# A pending sunset with a successor keeps it; otherwise the rate in force.
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						var:te_tax_en_div_exp < 0
						var:te_tax_en_div_succ < 0
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div_succ value = var:te_tax_en_div }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div_succ value = -1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = var:te_tax_pb_div }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div_since value = var:te_tax_now }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div_exp value = var:te_tax_pb_div_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_pb_land >= 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_tax_pb_land_exp >= 0 }
			# A pending sunset with a successor keeps it; otherwise the rate in force.
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						var:te_tax_en_land_exp < 0
						var:te_tax_en_land_succ < 0
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land_succ value = var:te_tax_en_land }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land_succ value = -1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = var:te_tax_pb_land }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land_since value = var:te_tax_now }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land_exp value = var:te_tax_pb_land_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_pb_head >= 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_tax_pb_head_exp >= 0 }
			# A pending sunset with a successor keeps it; otherwise the rate in force.
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						var:te_tax_en_head_exp < 0
						var:te_tax_en_head_succ < 0
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head_succ value = var:te_tax_en_head }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head_succ value = -1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = var:te_tax_pb_head }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head_since value = var:te_tax_now }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head_exp value = var:te_tax_pb_head_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_pb_cons >= 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_tax_pb_cons_exp >= 0 }
			# A pending sunset with a successor keeps it; otherwise the rate in force.
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						var:te_tax_en_cons_exp < 0
						var:te_tax_en_cons_succ < 0
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons_succ value = var:te_tax_en_cons }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons_succ value = -1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = var:te_tax_pb_cons }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons_since value = var:te_tax_now }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons_exp value = var:te_tax_pb_cons_exp }
	}
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_aeroplanes >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_aeroplanes value = var:te_tax_pb_g_aeroplanes } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_automobiles >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_automobiles value = var:te_tax_pb_g_automobiles } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_clippers >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_clippers value = var:te_tax_pb_g_clippers } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_clothes >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_clothes value = var:te_tax_pb_g_clothes } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_coal >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_coal value = var:te_tax_pb_g_coal } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_coffee >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_coffee value = var:te_tax_pb_g_coffee } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_consumer_appliances >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_consumer_appliances value = var:te_tax_pb_g_consumer_appliances } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_digital_access >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_digital_access value = var:te_tax_pb_g_digital_access } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_digital_assets >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_digital_assets value = var:te_tax_pb_g_digital_assets } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_electricity >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_electricity value = var:te_tax_pb_g_electricity } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_fabric >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_fabric value = var:te_tax_pb_g_fabric } }

	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_luxury_furniture >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_luxury_furniture value = var:te_tax_pb_g_luxury_furniture } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_meat >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_meat value = var:te_tax_pb_g_meat } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_oil >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_oil value = var:te_tax_pb_g_oil } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_opium >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_opium value = var:te_tax_pb_g_opium } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_paper >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_paper value = var:te_tax_pb_g_paper } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_porcelain >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_porcelain value = var:te_tax_pb_g_porcelain } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_radios >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_radios value = var:te_tax_pb_g_radios } }

	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_tea >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_tea value = var:te_tax_pb_g_tea } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_telephones >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_telephones value = var:te_tax_pb_g_telephones } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_tobacco >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_tobacco value = var:te_tax_pb_g_tobacco } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_tourism >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_tourism value = var:te_tax_pb_g_tourism } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_transportation >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_transportation value = var:te_tax_pb_g_transportation } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_wine >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_wine value = var:te_tax_pb_g_wine } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_wood >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_wood value = var:te_tax_pb_g_wood } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_agrel >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_agrel value = var:te_tax_pb_agrel } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_regrel >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_regrel value = var:te_tax_pb_regrel } }
	# Customs (plan Task 15), only while the code holds the country's customs (a package
	# that touches them is current only if no market change moved te_tax_xver_customs since
	# approval): each level the package sets becomes the enacted one, with the good's failed
	# re-assert count and blocked mark dropped; the sync then sets the market's level.
	if = {
		limit = { te_tax_customs_authority = yes has_variable = te_tax_pb_pver_customs }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_imp_advanced_materials >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_advanced_materials value = var:te_tax_pb_imp_advanced_materials } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_advanced_materials } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_advanced_materials } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_advanced_materials } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_advanced_materials } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_exp_advanced_materials >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_advanced_materials value = var:te_tax_pb_exp_advanced_materials } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_advanced_materials } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_advanced_materials } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_advanced_materials } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_advanced_materials } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_imp_aeroplanes >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_aeroplanes value = var:te_tax_pb_imp_aeroplanes } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_aeroplanes } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_aeroplanes } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_aeroplanes } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_aeroplanes } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_exp_aeroplanes >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_aeroplanes value = var:te_tax_pb_exp_aeroplanes } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_aeroplanes } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_aeroplanes } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_aeroplanes } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_aeroplanes } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_imp_ammunition >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_ammunition value = var:te_tax_pb_imp_ammunition } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_ammunition } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_ammunition } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_ammunition } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_ammunition } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_exp_ammunition >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_ammunition value = var:te_tax_pb_exp_ammunition } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_ammunition } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_ammunition } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_ammunition } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_ammunition } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_imp_artillery >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_artillery value = var:te_tax_pb_imp_artillery } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_artillery } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_artillery } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_artillery } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_artillery } }
