		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_imp_automobiles >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_automobiles value = var:te_tax_pb_imp_automobiles } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_automobiles } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_automobiles } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_automobiles } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_automobiles } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_exp_automobiles >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_automobiles value = var:te_tax_pb_exp_automobiles } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_automobiles } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_automobiles } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_automobiles } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_automobiles } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_imp_clippers >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_clippers value = var:te_tax_pb_imp_clippers } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_clippers } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_clippers } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_clippers } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_clippers } }

		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_imp_small_arms >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_small_arms value = var:te_tax_pb_imp_small_arms } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_small_arms } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_small_arms } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_small_arms } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_small_arms } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_exp_small_arms >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_small_arms value = var:te_tax_pb_exp_small_arms } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_small_arms } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_small_arms } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_small_arms } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_small_arms } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_imp_steamers >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_steamers value = var:te_tax_pb_imp_steamers } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_steamers } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_steamers } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_steamers } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_steamers } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_exp_steamers >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_steamers value = var:te_tax_pb_exp_steamers } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_steamers } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_steamers } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_steamers } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_steamers } }

		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_imp_sugar >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_sugar value = var:te_tax_pb_imp_sugar } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_sugar } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_sugar } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_sugar } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_sugar } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_exp_sugar >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_sugar value = var:te_tax_pb_exp_sugar } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_sugar } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_sugar } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_sugar } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_sugar } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_imp_sulfur >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_sulfur value = var:te_tax_pb_imp_sulfur } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_sulfur } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_sulfur } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_sulfur } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_sulfur } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_exp_sulfur >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_sulfur value = var:te_tax_pb_exp_sulfur } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_sulfur } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_sulfur } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_sulfur } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_sulfur } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_imp_tanks >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_tanks value = var:te_tax_pb_imp_tanks } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_tanks } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_tanks } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_tanks } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_tanks } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_exp_tanks >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_tanks value = var:te_tax_pb_exp_tanks } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_tanks } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_tanks } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_tanks } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_tanks } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_imp_tea >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_tea value = var:te_tax_pb_imp_tea } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_tea } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_tea } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_tea } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_tea } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_exp_tea >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_tea value = var:te_tax_pb_exp_tea } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_tea } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_tea } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_tea } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_tea } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_imp_tech_metals >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_tech_metals value = var:te_tax_pb_imp_tech_metals } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_tech_metals } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_tech_metals } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_tech_metals } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_tech_metals } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_exp_tech_metals >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_tech_metals value = var:te_tax_pb_exp_tech_metals } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_tech_metals } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_tech_metals } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_tech_metals } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_tech_metals } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_imp_telephones >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_telephones value = var:te_tax_pb_imp_telephones } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_telephones } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_telephones } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_telephones } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_telephones } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_exp_telephones >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_telephones value = var:te_tax_pb_exp_telephones } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_telephones } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_telephones } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_telephones } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_telephones } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_imp_tobacco >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_tobacco value = var:te_tax_pb_imp_tobacco } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_tobacco } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_tobacco } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_tobacco } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_tobacco } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_exp_tobacco >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_tobacco value = var:te_tax_pb_exp_tobacco } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_tobacco } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_tobacco } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_tobacco } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_tobacco } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_imp_tools >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_tools value = var:te_tax_pb_imp_tools } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_tools } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_tools } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_tools } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_tools } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_exp_tools >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_tools value = var:te_tax_pb_exp_tools } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_tools } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_tools } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_tools } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_tools } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_imp_tourism >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_tourism value = var:te_tax_pb_imp_tourism } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_tourism } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_tourism } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_tourism } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_tourism } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_exp_tourism >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_tourism value = var:te_tax_pb_exp_tourism } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_tourism } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_tourism } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_tourism } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_tourism } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_imp_wine >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_wine value = var:te_tax_pb_imp_wine } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_wine } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_wine } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_wine } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_wine } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_exp_wine >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_wine value = var:te_tax_pb_exp_wine } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_wine } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_wine } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_wine } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_wine } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_imp_wood >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_imp_wood value = var:te_tax_pb_imp_wood } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_wood } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_imp_wood } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_wood } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_imp_wood } }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_exp_wood >= -3 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_exp_wood value = var:te_tax_pb_exp_wood } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_wood } remove_variable = te_tax_cretry_exp_wood } if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_wood } remove_variable = te_tax_cblock_exp_wood } }
	}
	# A package that restates regional relief names its whole state set, its own list
	# te_tax_pb_relief_states: it replaces the enacted list te_tax_en_relief_states (the canonical set,
	# at most three) with the states in it that this code keeps (te_tax_relief_listed_state_kept:
	# its own, or its civil-war counterpart's while a war lasts). The state marks
	# (te_tax_relief_state) follow from the list in the writer's relief sync
	# (te_tax_rebuild_relief_marks), which the processor runs after this month's
	# commencements. The slot's list is consumed either way.
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_pb_regrel_states_set = 1 }
		save_scope_as = te_tax_country
		if = { limit = { has_variable_list = te_tax_en_relief_states } clear_variable_list = te_tax_en_relief_states }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable_list = te_tax_pb_relief_states }
			every_in_list = {
				variable = te_tax_pb_relief_states
				limit = { te_tax_relief_listed_state_kept = yes }
				scope:te_tax_country = { add_to_variable_list = { name = te_tax_en_relief_states target = PREV } }
			}
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { has_variable_list = te_tax_pb_relief_states } clear_variable_list = te_tax_pb_relief_states }
}

# Slot b: writes an approved package from the bill record (te_tax_bl_*). Called
# only through te_tax_store_package, after te_tax_can_store_package and with
# scope:te_tax_country saved. Every payload field is written, so nothing stale from an
# earlier package survives. A sunset is due + offset, written only for an offset of at
# least one month. _succ is a preview for the review only (commencement decides the
# successor then, by te_tax_gen_apply_<slot>'s rule): the underlying permanent rate,
# from the other slot's awaiting package if it touches the provision earlier, else
# from the enacted provision. seq = one above both slots. The slot is switched on last.
# _due0 keeps the approved month and _pver_<group> the planned versions after this
# approval, for te_tax_cmd_package_reschedule: a missed package may move only a few
# months, and only while no later approval has touched what it changes.
te_tax_gen_store_b = {
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_due value = var:te_tax_bl_due }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_due0 value = var:te_tax_bl_due }
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_pa_seq > var:te_tax_pb_seq }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_seq value = var:te_tax_pa_seq }
	}
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_seq add = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_wage value = var:te_tax_bl_wage }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_xver_wage value = var:te_tax_bl_xver_wage }
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_bl_wage >= 0
			var:te_tax_bl_wage_sun >= 1
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_wage_exp value = var:te_tax_bl_due }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_wage_exp add = var:te_tax_bl_wage_sun }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_wage_succ value = var:te_tax_en_wage }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:te_tax_en_wage_exp >= 0
				var:te_tax_en_wage_succ >= 0
			}
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_wage_succ value = var:te_tax_en_wage_succ }
		}
		# The other slot's payload exists only while it is on, so read it nested.
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:te_tax_pa_on = 1
				var:te_tax_pa_state = 1
				var:te_tax_pa_due < var:te_tax_bl_due
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_tax_pa_wage >= 0 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_wage_succ value = var:te_tax_pa_wage }
				if = {
					limit = {
						var:te_tax_pa_wage_exp >= 0
						var:te_tax_pa_wage_succ >= 0
					}
					set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_wage_succ value = var:te_tax_pa_wage_succ }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_wage_exp value = -1 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_wage_succ value = -1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_div value = var:te_tax_bl_div }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_xver_div value = var:te_tax_bl_xver_div }
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_bl_div >= 0
			var:te_tax_bl_div_sun >= 1
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_div_exp value = var:te_tax_bl_due }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_div_exp add = var:te_tax_bl_div_sun }

			set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_div_succ value = var:te_tax_en_div_succ }
		}
		# The other slot's payload exists only while it is on, so read it nested.
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:te_tax_pa_on = 1
				var:te_tax_pa_state = 1
				var:te_tax_pa_due < var:te_tax_bl_due
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_tax_pa_div >= 0 }

					limit = {
						var:te_tax_pa_div_exp >= 0
						var:te_tax_pa_div_succ >= 0
					}
					set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_div_succ value = var:te_tax_pa_div_succ }
				}
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { has_variable_list = te_tax_bl_relief_states }
			every_in_list = {

		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_imp_sugar value = var:te_tax_bl_imp_sugar }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_exp_sugar value = var:te_tax_bl_exp_sugar }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_imp_sulfur value = var:te_tax_bl_imp_sulfur }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_exp_sulfur value = var:te_tax_bl_exp_sulfur }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_imp_tanks value = var:te_tax_bl_imp_tanks }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_exp_tanks value = var:te_tax_bl_exp_tanks }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_imp_tea value = var:te_tax_bl_imp_tea }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_exp_tea value = var:te_tax_bl_exp_tea }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_imp_tech_metals value = var:te_tax_bl_imp_tech_metals }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_exp_tech_metals value = var:te_tax_bl_exp_tech_metals }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_imp_telephones value = var:te_tax_bl_imp_telephones }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_exp_telephones value = var:te_tax_bl_exp_telephones }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_imp_tobacco value = var:te_tax_bl_imp_tobacco }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_exp_tobacco value = var:te_tax_bl_exp_tobacco }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_imp_tools value = var:te_tax_bl_imp_tools }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_exp_tools value = var:te_tax_bl_exp_tools }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_imp_tourism value = var:te_tax_bl_imp_tourism }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_exp_tourism value = var:te_tax_bl_exp_tourism }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_imp_wine value = var:te_tax_bl_imp_wine }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_exp_wine value = var:te_tax_bl_exp_wine }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_imp_wood value = var:te_tax_bl_imp_wood }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_exp_wood value = var:te_tax_bl_exp_wood }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_xver_customs value = var:te_tax_bl_xver_customs }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_pver_customs value = var:te_tax_pver_customs }
	}
	if = { limit = { is_ai = no } debug_log = "TE_TAX stored slot=b; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]" }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_state value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_on value = 1 }
}

# te_tax_next_month: the earliest month with a transition due, -1 if none. Enacted
# sunsets and awaiting packages count; a held package waits for rescheduling and does
# not. A deferred sunset keeps it at the current month until it runs.
te_tax_gen_next_month = {
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_next_month value = -1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_en_wage_exp >= 0
			OR = {
				var:te_tax_next_month < 0
				var:te_tax_en_wage_exp < var:te_tax_next_month
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_next_month value = var:te_tax_en_wage_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_en_div_exp >= 0
			OR = {
				var:te_tax_next_month < 0
				var:te_tax_en_div_exp < var:te_tax_next_month
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_next_month value = var:te_tax_en_div_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_en_land_exp >= 0
			OR = {
				var:te_tax_next_month < 0
				var:te_tax_en_land_exp < var:te_tax_next_month
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_next_month value = var:te_tax_en_land_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_en_head_exp >= 0
			OR = {
				var:te_tax_next_month < 0
				var:te_tax_en_head_exp < var:te_tax_next_month
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_next_month value = var:te_tax_en_head_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_en_cons_exp >= 0
			OR = {
				var:te_tax_next_month < 0
				var:te_tax_en_cons_exp < var:te_tax_next_month
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_next_month value = var:te_tax_en_cons_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_pa_on = 1
			var:te_tax_pa_state = 1
			OR = {
				var:te_tax_next_month < 0
				var:te_tax_pa_due < var:te_tax_next_month
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_next_month value = var:te_tax_pa_due }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_pb_on = 1
			var:te_tax_pb_state = 1
			OR = {
				var:te_tax_next_month < 0
				var:te_tax_pb_due < var:te_tax_next_month
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_next_month value = var:te_tax_pb_due }
	}
}

# The history ring: 8 entries te_tax_h<n>_*, te_tax_h_head pointing at the newest
# (0 = empty). Advances the head, then overwrites that entry. KIND: the schema doc's
# history kinds; SLOT: none, a or b (stored as te_tax_slot_id_<SLOT>); INST: 1..5 for
# the instrument a sunset executed (INSTRUMENTS order), else 0. Public entry point:
# te_tax_history_push = { KIND SLOT }.
te_tax_gen_history_write = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_h_head >= 1
			var:te_tax_h_head < 8
		}
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_h_head add = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h_head value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_h_head = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h1_month value = te_history_month_index }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h1_kind value = $KIND$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h1_slot value = te_tax_slot_id_$SLOT$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h1_inst value = $INST$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h1_version value = var:te_tax_code_version }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_h_head = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h2_month value = te_history_month_index }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h2_kind value = $KIND$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h2_slot value = te_tax_slot_id_$SLOT$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h2_inst value = $INST$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h2_version value = var:te_tax_code_version }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_h_head = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h3_month value = te_history_month_index }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h3_kind value = $KIND$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h3_slot value = te_tax_slot_id_$SLOT$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h3_inst value = $INST$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h3_version value = var:te_tax_code_version }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_h_head = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h4_month value = te_history_month_index }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h4_kind value = $KIND$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h4_slot value = te_tax_slot_id_$SLOT$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h4_inst value = $INST$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h4_version value = var:te_tax_code_version }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_h_head = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h5_month value = te_history_month_index }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h5_kind value = $KIND$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h5_slot value = te_tax_slot_id_$SLOT$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h5_inst value = $INST$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h5_version value = var:te_tax_code_version }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_h_head = 6 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h6_month value = te_history_month_index }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h6_kind value = $KIND$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h6_slot value = te_tax_slot_id_$SLOT$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h6_inst value = $INST$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h6_version value = var:te_tax_code_version }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_h_head = 7 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h7_month value = te_history_month_index }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h7_kind value = $KIND$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h7_slot value = te_tax_slot_id_$SLOT$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h7_inst value = $INST$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h7_version value = var:te_tax_code_version }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_h_head = 8 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h8_month value = te_history_month_index }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h8_kind value = $KIND$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h8_slot value = te_tax_slot_id_$SLOT$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h8_inst value = $INST$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h8_version value = var:te_tax_code_version }
	}
}

# Migration, rates: the enacted indices that reproduce the active vanilla taxation law at
# the country's native tax level, one branch per (law, level) pair (MIGRATION in the
# generator). Every branch writes all five indices. A country already on the carrier
# without tokens (a rebel or a released country that inherited it), or on any other law
# (the probe carrier, another mod's law), migrates as all zeros and is flagged.
# Called only by te_tax_migrate_country.
te_tax_gen_migrate_rates = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation tax_level = very_low }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation tax_level = low }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation tax_level = medium }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation tax_level = high }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation tax_level = very_high }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 7 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation tax_level = very_low }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 16 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation tax_level = low }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 22 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation tax_level = medium }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 28 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation tax_level = high }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 34 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation tax_level = very_high }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 40 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 7 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation tax_level = very_low }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 8 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 8 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation tax_level = low }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 11 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 11 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation tax_level = medium }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 14 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 14 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation tax_level = high }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 17 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 17 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation tax_level = very_high }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 6 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 20 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 20 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 7 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation tax_level = very_low }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation tax_level = low }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 6 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation tax_level = medium }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 8 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation tax_level = high }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 10 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 6 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation tax_level = very_high }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 12 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 8 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 7 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation tax_level = very_low }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation tax_level = low }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 6 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation tax_level = medium }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 6 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 8 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation tax_level = high }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 7 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 10 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation tax_level = very_high }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 8 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 12 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 7 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_te_tax_code }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_migration_discrepancy value = 1 }
		debug_log = "TE_TAX migration_discrepancy holds law_te_tax_code without migration tokens; every rate migrated as 0; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_migration_discrepancy value = 1 }
		debug_log = "TE_TAX migration_discrepancy no mapping for the active taxation law; every rate migrated as 0; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
	}
}

# Migration, goods: a catalog good is on the enacted list exactly when the country taxes
# it natively. A good outside the catalog is not carried; the first sync removes it.
te_tax_gen_migrate_goods = {
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:aeroplanes } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_aeroplanes value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_aeroplanes value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:automobiles } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_automobiles value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_automobiles value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:clippers } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_clippers value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_clippers value = 0 } }

	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_coal value = 0 } }

	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_digital_access value = 0 } }

	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_digital_assets value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:electricity } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_electricity value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_electricity value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:fabric } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_fabric value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_fabric value = 0 } }

	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_fruit value = 0 } }

	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_groceries value = 0 } }

	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:tourism } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_tourism value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_tourism value = 0 } }

	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_transportation value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:wine } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_wine value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_wine value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:wood } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_wood value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_wood value = 0 } }
	# A migration is a change made outside legislation.
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_xver_goods add = 1 }
}

# Migration, provisions: a collected instrument is operative from this month; none has
# a sunset or a successor. A migration is a change made outside legislation, so each
# instrument's external-change token moves.
te_tax_gen_migrate_provisions = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_en_wage > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage_since value = te_history_month_index }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage_since value = -1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage_exp value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage_succ value = -1 }
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_xver_wage add = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_en_div > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div_since value = te_history_month_index }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div_since value = -1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div_exp value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div_succ value = -1 }
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_xver_div add = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_en_land > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land_since value = te_history_month_index }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land_since value = -1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land_exp value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land_succ value = -1 }
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_xver_land add = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_en_head > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head_since value = te_history_month_index }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head_since value = -1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head_exp value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head_succ value = -1 }
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_xver_head add = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_en_cons > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons_since value = te_history_month_index }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons_since value = -1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons_exp value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons_succ value = -1 }
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_xver_cons add = 1 }
}

# Interest-group views of the enacted code (te_tax_refresh_ig_views, from the monthly
# processor and from te_tax.4, the sync after a migration, a re-assert or a copied code):
# each group's band (te_tax_ig_band_<ig>: its stance toward the vanilla taxation law the
# code is equivalent to, -2..2) keeps at most one te_tax_ig_view_<ig>_<band>
# on the country, and none at band 0. A band's modifier is added only where it is missing and
# the others are removed only where present, so an unchanged band changes nothing. Modifier
# changes are not visible later in the same effect; nothing here reads one back.
te_tax_gen_ig_views = {
	set_local_variable = { name = te_tax_band value = te_tax_ig_band_armed_forces }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = -2 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_armed_forces_m2 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_armed_forces_m2 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = -2 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_armed_forces_m2 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_armed_forces_m2 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = -1 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_armed_forces_m1 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_armed_forces_m1 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = -1 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_armed_forces_m1 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_armed_forces_m1 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = 1 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_armed_forces_p1 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_armed_forces_p1 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = 1 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_armed_forces_p1 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_armed_forces_p1 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = 2 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_armed_forces_p2 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_armed_forces_p2 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = 2 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_armed_forces_p2 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_armed_forces_p2 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_tax_band value = te_tax_ig_band_devout }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = -2 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_devout_m2 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_devout_m2 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = -2 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_devout_m2 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_devout_m2 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = -1 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_devout_m1 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_devout_m1 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = -1 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_devout_m1 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_devout_m1 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = 1 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_devout_p1 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_devout_p1 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = 1 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_devout_p1 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_devout_p1 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = 2 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_devout_p2 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_devout_p2 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = 2 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_devout_p2 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_devout_p2 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_tax_band value = te_tax_ig_band_industrialists }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = -2 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_industrialists_m2 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_industrialists_m2 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = -2 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_industrialists_m2 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_industrialists_m2 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = -1 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_industrialists_m1 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_industrialists_m1 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = -1 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_industrialists_m1 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_industrialists_m1 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = 1 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_industrialists_p1 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_industrialists_p1 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = 1 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_industrialists_p1 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_industrialists_p1 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = 2 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_industrialists_p2 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_industrialists_p2 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = 2 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_industrialists_p2 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_industrialists_p2 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_tax_band value = te_tax_ig_band_intelligentsia }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = -2 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_intelligentsia_m2 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_intelligentsia_m2 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = -2 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_intelligentsia_m2 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_intelligentsia_m2 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = -1 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_intelligentsia_m1 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_intelligentsia_m1 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = -1 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_intelligentsia_m1 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_intelligentsia_m1 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = 1 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_intelligentsia_p1 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_intelligentsia_p1 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = 1 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_intelligentsia_p1 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_intelligentsia_p1 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = 2 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_intelligentsia_p2 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_intelligentsia_p2 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = 2 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_intelligentsia_p2 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_intelligentsia_p2 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_tax_band value = te_tax_ig_band_landowners }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = -2 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_landowners_m2 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_landowners_m2 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = -2 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_landowners_m2 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_landowners_m2 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = -1 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_landowners_m1 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_landowners_m1 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = -1 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_landowners_m1 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_landowners_m1 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = 1 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_landowners_p1 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_landowners_p1 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = 1 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_landowners_p1 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_landowners_p1 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = 2 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_landowners_p2 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_landowners_p2 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = 2 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_landowners_p2 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_landowners_p2 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_tax_band value = te_tax_ig_band_petty_bourgeoisie }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = -2 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_petty_bourgeoisie_m2 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_petty_bourgeoisie_m2 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = -2 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_petty_bourgeoisie_m2 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_petty_bourgeoisie_m2 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = -1 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_petty_bourgeoisie_m1 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_petty_bourgeoisie_m1 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = -1 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_petty_bourgeoisie_m1 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_petty_bourgeoisie_m1 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = 1 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_petty_bourgeoisie_p1 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_petty_bourgeoisie_p1 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = 1 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_petty_bourgeoisie_p1 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_petty_bourgeoisie_p1 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = 2 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_petty_bourgeoisie_p2 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_petty_bourgeoisie_p2 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = 2 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_petty_bourgeoisie_p2 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_petty_bourgeoisie_p2 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_tax_band value = te_tax_ig_band_rural_folk }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = -2 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_rural_folk_m2 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_rural_folk_m2 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = -2 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_rural_folk_m2 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_rural_folk_m2 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = -1 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_rural_folk_m1 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_rural_folk_m1 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = -1 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_rural_folk_m1 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_rural_folk_m1 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = 1 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_rural_folk_p1 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_rural_folk_p1 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = 1 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_rural_folk_p1 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_rural_folk_p1 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = 2 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_rural_folk_p2 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_rural_folk_p2 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = 2 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_rural_folk_p2 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_rural_folk_p2 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_tax_band value = te_tax_ig_band_trade_unions }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = -2 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_trade_unions_m2 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_trade_unions_m2 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = -2 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_trade_unions_m2 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_trade_unions_m2 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = -1 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_trade_unions_m1 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_trade_unions_m1 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = -1 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_trade_unions_m1 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_trade_unions_m1 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = 1 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_trade_unions_p1 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_trade_unions_p1 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = 1 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_trade_unions_p1 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_trade_unions_p1 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = 2 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_trade_unions_p2 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_trade_unions_p2 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = 2 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_trade_unions_p2 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_trade_unions_p2 }
}

# Outbreak copy of the policy obligations (plan Task 12): the payload of every slot whose
# obligation binds the original (te_tax_obl_binding: bound to a passed bill, delivering or
# maintaining), with its clocks, so it binds the rebels on the same terms (spec 10: binding
# obligations follow the copied code). A pending one belongs to the bill, which stays with
# the government that wrote it: te_tax_copy_code releases it on the rebels afterwards.
te_tax_gen_copy_obligations = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:te_tax_source = { te_tax_obl_binding = { N = 1 } } }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o1_kind }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o1_arg }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o1_target }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o1_baseline }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o1_ig }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o1_deadline }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o1_maint_end }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o1_streak }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o1_fails }

# A released country starts with no obligation and no record of kept or broken promises
# (te_tax_init_released_country; a revived tag may carry them from an earlier life). The
# parent's obligations stay with the parent.
te_tax_gen_clear_obligations = {
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_o1_on value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_o1_state value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_o2_on value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_o2_state value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_o3_on value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_o3_state value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_o4_on value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_o4_state value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_armed_forces value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_devout value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_industrialists value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_intelligentsia value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_landowners value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_petty_bourgeoisie value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_rural_folk value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_trade_unions value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_armed_forces_month value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_devout_month value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_industrialists_month value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_intelligentsia_month value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_landowners_month value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_petty_bourgeoisie_month value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_rural_folk_month value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_trade_unions_month value = -1 }
}

	save_scope_as = te_tax_country
	if = { limit = { has_variable_list = te_tax_pa_relief_states } clear_variable_list = te_tax_pa_relief_states }
	if = {
		limit = { scope:te_tax_source = { has_variable_list = te_tax_pa_relief_states } }
		scope:te_tax_source = {
			every_in_list = {
				variable = te_tax_pa_relief_states
				scope:te_tax_country = { add_to_variable_list = { name = te_tax_pa_relief_states target = PREV } }
			}
		}
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = { scope:te_tax_source = { has_variable_list = te_tax_pb_relief_states } }
		scope:te_tax_source = {
			every_in_list = {
				variable = te_tax_pb_relief_states
				scope:te_tax_country = { add_to_variable_list = { name = te_tax_pb_relief_states target = PREV } }
			}

# Policy obligations' deadline line (plan 2026-10-03 Task 19), every country, once per
# promise as its delivery phase ends: te_tax_obl_check_one calls _met_<n> before a
# delivered promise starts maintenance and _unmet_<n> before the deadline breach, both
# while the slot is still on, so the views print its payload. ai=yes|no is literal in
# two lines, since debug_log cannot print is_ai. An AI's enacted promise (ai_obl_enacted)
# logs met at the next check; one it renegotiated (ai_renegotiated) logs neither.
te_tax_gen_obl_log_met_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = yes }
		debug_log = "TE_TAX obl_deadline result=met slot=1 kind=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_tax_view_o1_kind')|0] arg=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_tax_view_o1_arg')|0] target=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_tax_view_o1_target')|0] level=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_tax_view_o1_measure')|0] baseline=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_tax_view_o1_baseline')|0] deadline=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_tax_view_o1_deadline')|0] ai=yes; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
	}
	else = {
		debug_log = "TE_TAX obl_deadline result=met slot=1 kind=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_tax_view_o1_kind')|0] arg=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_tax_view_o1_arg')|0] target=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_tax_view_o1_target')|0] level=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_tax_view_o1_measure')|0] baseline=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_tax_view_o1_baseline')|0] deadline=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_tax_view_o1_deadline')|0] ai=no; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"

}

	}

# The AI enacts a kind-1 promise it is about to miss (plan 2026-10-03 Task 19, the owner's
# one exception to "the tax code never sets an institution's level"): called only by
# te_tax_ai_manage_promises (te_tax_ai_effects.txt), in te_tax.8, behind
# te_tax_ai_promise_at_risk and te_tax_ai_can_enact. It sets the promised institution to
# exactly the promised level, never above it; the setter takes a literal level, so there
# is a branch per level 1 to 9 (the mod's MAX_INSTITUTION_INVESTMENT,
# common/defines/extra_defines.txt), each inside has_institution. The institution's native
# costs apply from then on, and the monthly check still verifies the delivered level
# (capability ledger: pending P16).
te_tax_gen_ai_enact_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_o1_on var:te_tax_o1_on = 1 var:te_tax_o1_kind = 1 var:te_tax_o1_arg = 1 has_institution = institution_schools }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_o1_target = 1 } set_institution_investment_level = { institution = institution_schools level = 1 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_o1_target = 2 } set_institution_investment_level = { institution = institution_schools level = 2 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_o1_target = 3 } set_institution_investment_level = { institution = institution_schools level = 3 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_o1_target = 4 } set_institution_investment_level = { institution = institution_schools level = 4 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_o1_target = 5 } set_institution_investment_level = { institution = institution_schools level = 5 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_o1_target = 6 } set_institution_investment_level = { institution = institution_schools level = 6 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_o1_target = 7 } set_institution_investment_level = { institution = institution_schools level = 7 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_o1_target = 8 } set_institution_investment_level = { institution = institution_schools level = 8 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_o1_target = 9 } set_institution_investment_level = { institution = institution_schools level = 9 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_o1_on var:te_tax_o1_on = 1 var:te_tax_o1_kind = 1 var:te_tax_o1_arg = 2 has_institution = institution_health_system }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_o1_target = 1 } set_institution_investment_level = { institution = institution_health_system level = 1 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_o1_target = 2 } set_institution_investment_level = { institution = institution_health_system level = 2 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_o1_target = 3 } set_institution_investment_level = { institution = institution_health_system level = 3 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_o1_target = 4 } set_institution_investment_level = { institution = institution_health_system level = 4 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_o1_target = 5 } set_institution_investment_level = { institution = institution_health_system level = 5 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_o1_target = 6 } set_institution_investment_level = { institution = institution_health_system level = 6 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_o1_target = 7 } set_institution_investment_level = { institution = institution_health_system level = 7 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_o1_target = 8 } set_institution_investment_level = { institution = institution_health_system level = 8 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_o1_target = 9 } set_institution_investment_level = { institution = institution_health_system level = 9 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_o1_on var:te_tax_o1_on = 1 var:te_tax_o1_kind = 1 var:te_tax_o1_arg = 3 has_institution = institution_social_security }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_o1_target = 1 } set_institution_investment_level = { institution = institution_social_security level = 1 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_o1_target = 2 } set_institution_investment_level = { institution = institution_social_security level = 2 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_o1_target = 3 } set_institution_investment_level = { institution = institution_social_security level = 3 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_o1_target = 4 } set_institution_investment_level = { institution = institution_social_security level = 4 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_o1_target = 5 } set_institution_investment_level = { institution = institution_social_security level = 5 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_o1_target = 6 } set_institution_investment_level = { institution = institution_social_security level = 6 } }

# The AI's summary lines for a promise it enacted or renegotiated (te_tax_ai_log_*'s form):
# the slot, what it promised, the measure (level=) and when, then the fiscal signals.
# te_tax_ai_manage_promises writes each just before it acts: the setter's result is not
# assumed visible later in the block (level= is the level before the enactment), and a
# renegotiation frees the slot, after which its views read nothing. ROOT = THIS = the
